Everything feels completely unreal, which also might be partially because I had a baby five weeks ago, so I’m functioning on very little sleep. But it’s wild to see the scope of this because I come from the novel-writing world and there, I feel like I am doing so much and I feel like the success of the book is — you might know this as a fellow book writer — “If this book does not become a bestseller, it’s because I failed.” And here it’s like, “Oh wow, I just opened my phone at 2 a.m. when I’m breastfeeding and Sunny Sandler’s on *Jimmy Fallon* doing an incredible job promoting the film.” And it’s been really wonderful to see the reactions coming in. And it’s so nice feeling like there’s this whole team of people who also worked on this — from directors to producers to actors to the crew — and everybody is so invested in its success.
